mechanism_narrative: ERBB4 (RTK, ECD=626aa) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor, ECD=597aa) are co-expressed in aged MF-II myofibers (ERBB4: old pc=0.43, me=1.06; IL6ST: old pc=0.19, me=0.35). Under forced proximity via flexible_GS8 linker (~40 A), ERBB4's tyrosine kinase domain (718-985) transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular tyrosines, while JAK1/JAK2/TYK2 constitutively associated with IL6ST's Box1/Box2 motifs reciprocally phosphorylate ERBB4. This creates a biased signaling output: GRB2/SHC1/GAB1/PIK3R1 are recruited to the combined phosphotyrosine landscape, driving MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT/mTOR activation (analogous to H2F wins). STAT3 is additionally recruited to IL6ST pY905, creating a novel JAK/STAT3 activation axis amplified by ERBB4 kinase activity. PLCG1 is sterically excluded by the co-cluster geometry (same exclusion principle as H2F). The biased transcriptome shift upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) via SRF/ELK1 downstream of MAPK, and downregulates aged IEG/inflammatory markers (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP, MYF5) via AKT-mediated FOXO inactivation and reduced stress signaling.
